item.title: Underpowered and too many different snake species
item.description: Agreement I do not AgreeBody I have followed the development of varespladib for several years. It remains a promising drug with superb animal data. This ambitious study bit of more than it can chew. First, the study is underpowered, because it included at least 10 snake species on two continents. It is effectively 10 small studies instead of one modest sized study. Second, the snake species are quite different.
